data.name: Jade Master: Chronicle
data.detailed_description:
Jade Master: Chronicle is a business simulation game centered on appraising rough jadeite, crafting jade pieces, and managing your own shop.

From bustling stone markets to opportunity-filled auctions, you must rely on your discerning eye to evaluate each stone’s rind, color, and hidden potential while balancing risk against reward. Every bid and every cut can change the course of your business—one slice may reveal brilliant green jade, while a poor judgment could turn a promising investment into a costly loss.

Bring your newly acquired stones into the workshop and experience the hands-on processes of cutting, pressing, and polishing. Examine the quality and structure revealed within each stone, choose the most suitable crafting approach, and create jade pieces tailored to your customers’ requests. Produce everything from classic bangles to refined plaques, pendants, ornaments, and display pieces—each creation shaped by your judgment, craftsmanship, and business strategy.

Complete orders, sell your finished jade pieces, and accumulate the funds needed to expand your business. Upgrade your shop, workshop, and machinery to improve efficiency and craftsmanship, preparing yourself to create rarer and more valuable works. As your reputation grows, you will encounter increasingly precious rough stones and more demanding commissions, sharpening your eye and refining your skills with every purchase and every cut.

Collect a wide variety of high-quality jade pieces and complete your personal collection compendium. Begin with an unassuming rough stone, uncover the beauty hidden within, and transform it into an heirloom worthy of admiration and preservation. Build your legacy and write your own story in the world of jade.

data.short_description: Build your jade business from the ground up. Evaluate rough stones in the market, compete against rival dealers at auction, and master cutting, shaping, and polishing. Fulfill custom orders, upgrade your shop and workshop, and complete a collection of 66 exquisite jade pieces.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core processor, 2.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible graphics with WebGL support and up-to-date drivers
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Minimum display resolution: 1280 × 720. Steam client required. Internet connection is required for Steam Cloud synchronization.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern integrated or dedicated DirectX 11-compatible graphics with WebGL support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: 1920 × 1080 display and an SSD are recommended.
